title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.8.7
subtitle: Faster Resume and a safer Bake window.

highlights.title: Resume without repeated Collider export
highlights.description: Resume reuses the checkpoint's verified Scene data instead of capturing animated Colliders and Pins a second time.

highlights.title: Controlled Bake cancellation
highlights.description: The native window close button stays disabled during active work, keeping Cancel as the safe interruption path.

highlights.title: Accurate capture status
highlights.description: Force-only preparation is now reported as Force capture rather than an animated Collider export.
